baseline.scope: Production public UI with modeled native IPC/clipboard. Passive observation copies the small real codec Worker input without changing it; no Studio/document hooks. Raw state, actual PNG output, saved/dirty UI and observable Undo/Redo are checked. Numeric revision IDs and actual OS write failures are not directly inspected.

redoRca.expectedBehavior: No-op while pending. The disabled QAction state in mainwindow.cpp and the actual Qt key fixture override an interpretation based only on its dormant callback body.

isolation.existingNamespaces: All file access denied by macOS sandbox-exec; no directory list/read/hash or recovery mutation allowed.
isolation.homeOverride: A metadata-only QStandardPaths preflight showed that macOS ignores temporary HOME/XDG for this AppLocalDataLocation. Initial UI run was aborted before dispatch.
isolation.effect: MainWindow recovery folder initialization is denied. These results cover pending editing contracts, not recovery functionality.

all raw RGBA including hidden RGB

independentOracleRecommendations: Use a known two-layer raw-RGBA fixture with active index 1 and hidden RGB under alpha zero, plus a preexisting Redo branch. Ensure pending output differs from the committed source before testing abort.

Capture every layer RGBA/name/visibility, background/dimensions/active, revision/saved identity, history cursor/length and pending geometry/text/source bytes before each boundary; compare unchanged after abort.
Preserve native modeled project binding and existing file bytes on picker cancellation and pre-commit failure. Test successful commit with delayed response separately.

After each boundary, complete pending exactly once, compare against the captured candidate, Undo to exact committed source and Redo to exact candidate. Successful project save additionally makes Redo return to the saved revision.

Qt Undo while pending cancels only pending. Qt Redo action is disabled while pending, so Redo keyboard/trigger must do nothing and preserve pending plus underlying history; after Esc, the old Redo branch must remain executable. Callback-only analysis would incorrectly infer that pending Redo cancels it.

redoActionProbe.purpose: Independent actual Qt keyboard delivery fixture, no MainWindow or data storage. Every standard Redo binding triggers enabled QAction and is blocked when disabled; direct trigger() is also blocked.

qtOriginalMatrix.reviewCorrection: Initial callback-only advice that pending Redo cancels pending was incomplete. sync() disables Redo, and actual QAction keyboard probe demonstrates that public Qt Redo is a no-op while pending.

coldRenderAudit.method: Read-only source/document/raw existing measurement audit. No new timing runs; no overlap with SRE sixteen-layer final-scene experiment.

threshold.meaning: Initial candidate target: no >=50ms UI long task during active drawing, with no authoritative input queue buildup. Separate event-to-next-valid-display p95 candidate is 33ms. Not a universal <=50ms total mip completion contract. QF-03 target-device acceptance remains open.
threshold.currentGate: docs/STUDIO_MAX_DOCUMENT.md:44 treats initial cold rendering as an open responsiveness gate. Existing synchronous cold render blocks main thread; therefore the present samples fail both elapsed and long-task criteria.
threshold.limits: Desktop Chrome SwiftShader instrumented fixed bundle samples, not physical input-to-photon, WK/Windows/Android certification, or isolated mip-kernel timing.

recommendedNextUnit.name: Bounded cooperative mip preparation separated from synchronous visible drawing
recommendedNextUnit.reason: General input-safe path without another whole-document buffer, same current exact box-average math. The existing draw API combines full computation and drawing in one rAF call.
recommendedNextUnit.step: One owned resumable source-row/source-column accumulator; time slice around 4-8ms plus hard source-pixel count, yield to the browser task/render loop. Output-row-only or tile-only yields are insufficient at high reduction factors. Include current uniformBlock full source scan in slicing.
recommendedNextUnit.publication: Publish completed valid tiles only; no Canvas context transform/save held across await. Explicit initial preparation UI, preserve prior valid frame when appropriate. Prioritize active dirty regions over background cold work and bound backlog; a responsive spinner alone does not satisfy drawing latency.
recommendedNextUnit.quality: Keep current premultiplied box average over every source contribution, odd-edge real counts, zero-alpha display RGB normalization, raw source hidden RGB untouched, same world clips and no mip at 1:1.
recommendedNextUnit.ownership: Borrow source as readonly; never detach authority. Per-owner/tile source dirty generation plus document epoch, pixel-array identity, dimensions, factor, transform/version. Invalidate before the next asynchronous chunk can resume, including main.draw immediate dirty registration; do not use global revision alone because metadata or disjoint changes would restart unrelated work.
recommendedNextUnit.cancellation: Document replacement, retain/clear/evict, zoom factor or transform change and source dirty overlap invalidate jobs. Resume/final publication recheck. Late completion cannot resurrect discarded owners. Incomplete scratch/private tile released on abort/error; unfinished dirty work remains pending.
recommendedNextUnit.memory: Count current cache plus staged ImageData/Canvas, sums, row scratch and queued copies against <=128MiB estimated RGBA/scratch budget and <=64 tile slots. No extra full-frame CPU canvas; surfaces <=512. Reserve before allocation, cancel/evict jobs before releasing their resources.

alternatives.name: Whole-document Worker
alternatives.issue: Native authority is up to256MiB aggregate. Structured clone adds another256MiB plus synchronous producer copy pressure; original transfer would detach authoritative pixels. Worker moving CPU alone does not certify input/display responsiveness.

alternatives.name: Bounded strip Worker
alternatives.issue: Copy+transfer only small source strips with at most one bounded in-flight request, count inputs/outputs/scratch in budget, serializable selection cut descriptor and generation checks. Measure producer copy long tasks and queue latency; no SharedArrayBuffer requirement.

alternatives.name: Trusted known-uniform seed
alternatives.issue: Register only directly created/known-filled actual pixel owners with validated RGBA; never infer from background/name/first pixel. Invalidate changed cells. Helps white/transparent new documents, not arbitrary imports. layer-add clones existing sources via pendingState and draw(true) invalidates all; seeding only the new blank layer cannot by itself close465ms case.

acceptance: Same fixed bundle/device conditions, separate total cold completion, max task duration, RAF/input-to-valid-display and source/job queue age.
Exact output and raw-source hash against existing strict odd-alpha/thin-feature oracles, full 1:1 behavior unchanged.
Mid-generation stroke/Undo/new document/zoom/selection cancel preserve exact latest pixels and never publish stale/mixed generations.
Worst-case mixed/high-frequency maximum document, not only uniform seeds; alpha/odd dimensions/unaligned arrays/transform callback paths.
<=128MiB estimated storage including in-flight job resources, clear/error/eviction returns resources, no original buffer detach.

manifest.scope: Actual APFS async Stage::write returned real OS errno28 for valid33,563,410-byte RPAINT save/recovery; original contents+listed metadata/binding/sequence/token preserved; Drop cleaned stages; after capacity release save/recovery retry succeeded. Does not certify induced rename/commit/directory-sync failure, Tauri IPC/WebView, OS picker, or Windows ENOSPC.
